_comment: Copied to settings.json by `bun run setup`. Every field is optional and blank means 'use the default'. Field docs are in _help below; delete that key if it bothers you, nothing reads it.

_help.handle: Creator handle shown on CTA slides and in the platform preview mockups.
_help.brandVoice: A sentence or two describing how your captions should sound, e.g. 'Blunt and practical. No hype. Short sentences.' Appended to the caption system prompt.
_help.exportDir: Where exported carousels are written. Defaults to ./exports. Supports ~ for your home directory.
_help.likenessPath: Absolute path to a photo of you, used as a reference image when 'Use my likeness' is checked.
_help.likenessDescription: Appended to the image prompt so the model gets your appearance right, e.g. 'The person in the image is a young adult male. Always generate a male person, not female.'
_help.communityUrl: Community or link-in-bio URL shown on flash-video footers, e.g. 'skool.com/your-community'. Left blank, the line is omitted.
_help.audioPath: Default audio bed for generated videos, e.g. 'audio/my-bed.mp3'. Relative to the app, or absolute. Supports ~.
_help.pythonPath: The interpreter that renders slides. Leave it blank: setup builds a project .venv with uv and the app finds it automatically. Set it only if you have a specific interpreter you must use, and know that different builds ship different FreeType versions, which changes exported pixels.
_help.fontPath: Body typeface. A filename in fonts/, e.g. 'MyBrand-Variable.ttf', or an absolute path. Left blank, the vendored Inter is used. The browser is served the same file, so the preview matches the export.
_help.monoFontPath: Monospace typeface for the terminal variant. Same rules as fontPath. Left blank, the search is Menlo, Monaco, then the vendored JetBrains Mono.
